name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-013 - Matriz documental y requisitos de oportunidades

parameters.query:
SELECT
    $1::UUID
        AS opportunity_analysis_id,

    $2::UUID
        AS organization_id,

    $3::UUID
        AS process_id,

    $4::TEXT
        AS process_reference,

    $5::TEXT
        AS process_name,

    TO_JSONB(document)
        AS document_record

FROM secop.process_documents AS document

WHERE document.process_id =
    $3::UUID

ORDER BY
    document.uploaded_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    document.external_document_id ASC;

WITH config AS (
    SELECT
        GREATEST(
            1,
            LEAST(
                COALESCE(
                    $1::INTEGER,
                    5
                ),
                50
            )
        ) AS max_opportunities_per_organization,

        GREATEST(
            1,
            LEAST(
                COALESCE(
                    $2::INTEGER,
                    30
                ),
                100
            )
        ) AS max_documents_per_opportunity
),

latest_analysis AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (
        analysis.organization_id,
        analysis.process_id
    )
        analysis.id
            AS opportunity_analysis_id,

        analysis.organization_id,
        analysis.search_profile_id,
        analysis.process_match_id,
        analysis.process_id,

        analysis.compatibility_score,
        analysis.confidence_score,
        analysis.decision,
        analysis.executive_summary,

        COALESCE(
            analysis.process_snapshot,
            '{}'::JSONB
        ) AS process_snapshot,

        analysis.updated_at

    FROM saas.opportunity_ai_analyses
        AS analysis

    JOIN saas.organizations
        AS organization
        ON organization.id =
           analysis.organization_id

    WHERE organization.status IN (
        'active',
        'trial'
    )

      AND analysis.analysis_status =
        'success'

      AND (NULLIF($3::TEXT, '') IS NULL OR analysis.organization_id = NULLIF($3::TEXT, '')::UUID)
      AND (NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') IS NULL OR analysis.process_id = NULLIF($4::TEXT, '')::UUID)

      AND analysis.decision IN (
          'participar',
          'revisar'
      )

    ORDER BY
        analysis.organization_id,
        analysis.process_id,
        analysis.updated_at DESC
),

eligible_opportunities AS (
    SELECT
        analysis.opportunity_analysis_id,

        analysis.organization_id,
        analysis.search_profile_id,
        analysis.process_match_id,
        analysis.process_id,

        organization.name
            AS organization_name,

        organization.slug
            AS organization_slug,

        analysis.compatibility_score,
        analysis.confidence_score,
        analysis.decision,
        analysis.executive_summary,

        process.secop_process_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                analysis.process_snapshot
                    ->> 'reference',
                ''
            ),
            process.reference
        ) AS process_reference,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                analysis.process_snapshot
                    ->> 'process_name',
                ''
            ),
            process.process_name
        ) AS process_name,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                analysis.process_snapshot
                    ->> 'description',
                ''
            ),
            process.process_name
        ) AS process_description,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                analysis.process_snapshot
                    ->> 'entity_name',
                ''
            ),
            process.entity_name
        ) AS entity_name,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                analysis.process_snapshot
                    ->> 'procurement_method',
                ''
            ),
            process.procurement_method
        ) AS procurement_method,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                analysis.process_snapshot
                    ->> 'base_price',
                ''
            ),
            process.base_price::TEXT
        ) AS base_price,

        process.process_status,

        document_summary.documents_count,

        config.max_documents_per_opportunity,

        analysis.process_snapshot,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                analysis.organization_id

            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN analysis.decision =
                        'participar'
                        THEN 0

                    ELSE 1
                END,

                analysis.compatibility_score
                    DESC NULLS LAST,

                analysis.confidence_score
                    DESC NULLS LAST,

                analysis.updated_at DESC,

                analysis.process_id
        ) AS organization_rank

    FROM latest_analysis AS analysis

    JOIN saas.organizations
        AS organization
        ON organization.id =
           analysis.organization_id

    JOIN secop.processes
        AS process
        ON process.id =
           analysis.process_id

    CROSS JOIN config

    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                AS documents_count

        FROM secop.process_documents
            AS document

        WHERE document.process_id =
            analysis.process_id
    ) AS document_summary
        ON document_summary.documents_count > 0
)

SELECT
    opportunity.opportunity_analysis_id,

    opportunity.organization_id,
    opportunity.organization_name,
    opportunity.organization_slug,

    opportunity.search_profile_id,
    opportunity.process_match_id,
    opportunity.process_id,

    opportunity.compatibility_score,
    opportunity.confidence_score,
    opportunity.decision,
    opportunity.executive_summary,

    opportunity.secop_process_id,
    opportunity.process_reference,
    opportunity.process_name,
    opportunity.process_description,

    opportunity.entity_name,
    opportunity.procurement_method,
    opportunity.base_price,
    opportunity.process_status,

    opportunity.documents_count,
    opportunity.max_documents_per_opportunity,

    opportunity.organization_rank,
    opportunity.process_snapshot

FROM eligible_opportunities
    AS opportunity

CROSS JOIN config

WHERE opportunity.organization_rank <=
    config.max_opportunities_per_organization

ORDER BY
    opportunity.organization_name,
    opportunity.organization_rank;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO saas.opportunity_documents AS target (
    organization_id,
    opportunity_analysis_id,
    process_id,
    process_document_id,

    process_reference,
    document_name,
    source_file_extension,
    source_download_url,
    source_file_size_bytes,

    primary_category,
    detected_categories,
    relevant_for_analysis,
    selected_for_download,

    download_status,
    download_attempt_count,
    last_download_attempt_at,
    downloaded_at,

    download_sha256,
    downloaded_mime_type,
    downloaded_file_extension,
    downloaded_file_size_bytes,
    download_error,

    extraction_status,
    ai_requirement_status,

    metadata,
    created_at,
    updated_at
)

VALUES (
    $1::UUID,
    $2::UUID,
    $3::UUID,
    $4::UUID,

    NULLIF($5::TEXT, ''),
    $6::TEXT,
    NULLIF($7::TEXT, ''),
    NULLIF($8::TEXT, ''),
    $9::BIGINT,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF($10::TEXT, ''),
        'other'
    ),

    COALESCE(
        $11::JSONB,
        '[]'::JSONB
    ),

    $12::BOOLEAN,
    TRUE,

    'downloaded',
    1,
    NOW(),
    NOW(),

    NULLIF($13::TEXT, ''),
    NULLIF($14::TEXT, ''),
    NULLIF($15::TEXT, ''),
    $16::BIGINT,
    NULL,

    'pending',
    'not_requested',

    COALESCE(
        $17::JSONB,
        '{}'::JSONB
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (
    organization_id,
    opportunity_analysis_id,
    process_document_id
)

DO UPDATE SET
    process_id =
        EXCLUDED.process_id,

    process_reference =
        EXCLUDED.process_reference,

    document_name =
        EXCLUDED.document_name,

    source_file_extension =
        EXCLUDED.source_file_extension,

    source_download_url =
        EXCLUDED.source_download_url,

    source_file_size_bytes =
        EXCLUDED.source_file_size_bytes,

    primary_category =
        EXCLUDED.primary_category,

    detected_categories =
        EXCLUDED.detected_categories,

    relevant_for_analysis =
        EXCLUDED.relevant_for_analysis,

    selected_for_download =
        TRUE,

    download_status =
        'downloaded',

    download_attempt_count =
        target.download_attempt_count + 1,

    last_download_attempt_at =
        NOW(),

    downloaded_at =
        NOW(),

    download_sha256 =
        EXCLUDED.download_sha256,

    downloaded_mime_type =
        EXCLUDED.downloaded_mime_type,

    downloaded_file_extension =
        EXCLUDED.downloaded_file_extension,

    downloaded_file_size_bytes =
        EXCLUDED.downloaded_file_size_bytes,

    download_error =
        NULL,

    extraction_status =
        CASE
            WHEN target.download_sha256
                IS DISTINCT FROM
                EXCLUDED.download_sha256
                THEN 'pending'

            WHEN target.extraction_status IN (
                'not_requested',
                'failed',
                'unsupported'
            )
                THEN 'pending'

            ELSE target.extraction_status
        END,

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            target.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || EXCLUDED.metadata,

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    target.id
        AS opportunity_document_id,

    target.organization_id,
    target.opportunity_analysis_id,
    target.process_id,
    target.process_document_id,

    target.document_name,
    target.primary_category,

    target.download_status,
    target.download_attempt_count,
    target.download_sha256,

    target.extraction_status,

    'download_success'
        AS document_result_type,

    target.updated_at;

parameters.query:
WITH target_analyses AS (
    SELECT
        value::UUID
            AS opportunity_analysis_id

    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
        $1::JSONB
    )
)

SELECT
    document.organization_id,
    document.opportunity_analysis_id,
    document.process_id,
    document.process_reference,

    COUNT(*)
        AS total_documents,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.selected_for_download =
            TRUE
    ) AS selected_documents,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.download_status =
            'downloaded'
    ) AS downloaded_documents,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.download_status =
            'failed'
    ) AS failed_documents,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.download_status =
            'skipped'
    ) AS secondary_documents,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.extraction_status =
            'pending'
    ) AS pending_extraction,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.extraction_status =
            'extracted'
    ) AS extracted_documents,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE document.ai_requirement_status =
            'success'
    ) AS ai_analyzed_documents,

    MAX(document.updated_at)
        AS last_updated_at

FROM saas.opportunity_documents
    AS document

JOIN target_analyses AS target
    ON target.opportunity_analysis_id =
       document.opportunity_analysis_id

GROUP BY
    document.organization_id,
    document.opportunity_analysis_id,
    document.process_id,
    document.process_reference

ORDER BY
    document.process_reference;
